span.div:
For an open pull request targeting main with no prior Auto PR Triage outcome:
First application of the 'open source' label while ready for review
OR first time a pull request already carrying that label moves from draft to ready for review

div.b: Does the pull request meet repository policy?

span.div:
The pull request closes (Fixes/Closes/Resolves) a same-repository issue marked 'actionable'
OR the author has triage+ permission for this repository
OR a triage+ maintainer took deliberate action on the pull request
OR the description says 'Supported by @login' for a triage+ maintainer, who is requested as a reviewer
OR the description says 'Part of #N' for a same-repository issue marked 'actionable'
OR the ownership analysis found that the change matches a team's bypass intake criteria

div.span:
Did the LLM call fail, or was a bypass
claim too uncertain to accept?

Keep the pull request open
Report the failed LLM call, if any
Defer to a human triager

span.div: Runs for every pull request that reaches this point

1. Codepath ownership: Match changed files to rules in
.github/auto-pr-triage/codepath_owners.txt.
2. Semantic ownership: Use an LLM and descriptions in
.github/auto-pr-triage/extra_ownership_metadata.json
to add ownership areas based on what the change does.
3. Bypass intake: The same LLM call judges whether the change
matches a team's bypass_intake_criteria in that file.

div.span:
Were any codepath or
semantic owners found?

span.div:
Ownership analysis produces two types of owners:
Direct GitHub targets: @user and @org/team handles
are already reviewer targets.
Team owner IDs: Resolve each ID through its roster in
.github/auto-pr-triage/team_members.json. A roster member
already covering the pull request as a direct codepath owner,
submitted reviewer, or pending reviewer satisfies the team.
Otherwise, choose the next eligible member by round robin.

div.span:
Did the LLM call fail, or does
any team owner lack a reviewer?

span.div:
A verified 'Supported by @login' maintainer
OR a triage+ maintainer who marked the issue 'actionable'
OR a reviewer requested by another triage+ maintainer
Codepath and semantic owners do not count

div.span:
Do not mark as triaged
Defer to a human triager

Do not mark as triaged
Report that semantic owners are missing
Defer to a human triager

Do not mark as triaged
Continue with any safely resolved reviewers
Report missing semantic owners or team owners
without a reviewer for human follow-up

Mark as triaged
Request the selected reviewers, supporters, and issue labelers
A handoff reviewer pulls in others for any uncovered concerns
